errors.evidence: The y-axis is not labeled. "Errors (BoolQ)" is the title of the chart.
The data point for rank 64 is visibly above the 0.3 mark, at approximately 0.31. The stated value of 0.28 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: The trend suggests that smaller adapters (lower rank) achieve lower generalization errors
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect generalization of the trend. The plot shows that the error at rank 4 is higher than the error at rank 16. The trend is non-monotonic (it decreases then increases), not a simple inverse relationship between rank and error.
